title: Convolutional networks infer abnormal blood chemistry from standard ECG
summary: Two CNN architectures classified 55 parameter-threshold combinations of 29 laboratory tests as normal or abnormal from 12-lead or lead II ECG with age and sex, using 266,896 MIMIC-IV samples from 104,664 subjects. In the 12-lead setting 20 of 55 combinations had a lower ROC-AUC bound above 0.7, with hypokalemia (potassium below 3.3 mEq/L) best at 0.834 (0.817-0.849). Evaluation on MIMIC-III-WDB ICU traces (79,855 samples, 5,292 subjects) showed reduced single-lead generalization; precision limits caution against interruptive alerts.
